entry.title: Standardizing an exposure classification for existing outputs (pre-BIP)
entry.summary:
Clear communication is paramount when it comes to user interface design, particularly in the development of digital wallets. The prose used should be straightforward and easily understandable. This approach not only aids in user comprehension but also supports uniformity across different platforms. By maintaining simplicity in the action keys, various wallets can effectively communicate the same essential advice, ensuring a cohesive user experience.
Moreover, each wallet should articulate both the rationale behind specific actions and their urgency in plain language. This will help users make informed decisions quickly and efficiently, enhancing the overall functionality and user-friendliness of the digital wallets. Ensuring that all users, regardless of their technical expertise, understand the instructions and warnings presented to them is critical for security and usability.
